name: Main Window
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Window sizes by video scale, always on top, mini size and picture-in-picture
description:
Resizes the window to 0.5–2× the video or fits it to the video's aspect ratio, and resizes it automatically when playback starts; never on top, always on top, on top while playing or while playing in fullscreen; mini size and the system's picture-in-picture; hides the pointer while playing.
→ Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P): Window
